sections.heading: VDB to Particlesoperator
sections.content: The VDB to Particles operator can be used to convert VDB meshes into particles.

sections.heading: VDB to Particles Rollout
sections.content:
Mesh to Particle: converts any generated VDB meshes into a single particle.Pack mesh with particles: packs any generated VDB meshes with particles.Grid name: the name of the source SDF grid.

Mesh to Particle: converts any generated VDB meshes into a single particle.

Pack mesh with particles: packs any generated VDB meshes with particles.

Grid name: the name of the source SDF grid.

sections.heading: Sphere packing
sections.content:
Max particles: the maximum number of particles to pack the VDB mesh with.Min/max radius: radial constraints applied to generated particles.Samples: the number of samples to use in the packing algorithm. Higher values increase packing accuracy.Allow overlap: when enabled, resulting particles are allowed to overlap. When disabled, no generated particles will overlap.

Max particles: the maximum number of particles to pack the VDB mesh with.

Min/max radius: radial constraints applied to generated particles.

Samples: the number of samples to use in the packing algorithm. Higher values increase packing accuracy.

Allow overlap: when enabled, resulting particles are allowed to overlap. When disabled, no generated particles will overlap.

sections.heading: VDB tracking
sections.content:
Assign unique ID: when enabled, each iteration of the sphere packing algorithm will assign a unique ID to the resulting particles.Channel: the name of the custom float data channel where the unique ID will be assigned.
